description:

Welcome to Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland 

tidy by day, vacuum ghosts by night.

satisfying tidying, with an optional ghost problem.

Uncle Tony's toy store is a disaster. Piles of plushies, mountains of blocks, and not a single toy on the right shelf. Pick them up, carry them over and watch every shelf fill up row by row, with a rising pitch for every correct toy.

When midnight Clocks? The lights shift, the music changes, and the ghosts come out to play.

TIDY UP BY DAY

Sort toys onto shelves that match their category and size.

Watch shelf and store progress rise as you work.

Earn coins for every correct placement.

Spend coins on upgrades: carry more toys, pick up from further away, magnet same-type toys, scan for what's left, and unlock running and jumping.

Take calls from Uncle Tony, an enthusiastic boss who speaks fluent gibberish, gives you objectives and sends surprise cash.

VACUUM GHOSTS BY NIGHT

Receive Tony's ghost vacuum as a gift.

description:
Greetings from El Rey: official reveal trailer.

A noir 2.5D platformer in which Satrapo explores a sealed city through a rotating 2D perspective, engaged in an obsessive hunt for the mysterious R. A paranoid tale about desire, featuring eccentric characters and complex three-dimensional labyrinths.

── SYNOPSIS ──
Greetings from El Rey
A noir 2.5D platformer in which a paranoid detective explores a sealed city through a rotating 2D perspective, engaged in an obsessive hunt for the mysterious R. 
Explore an intricate three-dimensional labyrinth, solve spatial puzzles and master challenging sections, adapting classic platforming mechanics with world rotation. Confront bosses that warp the world outside the playfield, where your weapons are movement, timing and spatial awareness.
 A singular, diegetic external layout that interacts with gameplay and story, providing context and meaning to every player action.
El Rey has two rules. Entry demands a high price. Once inside, you never get out.
Here Satrapo pursues R., a phantom shaped by discordant stories, navigating eccentric figures, erratic prophecies and above all, a city built on lies.
Greetings from El Rey is a paranoid tale about desire, always shifting and reshaping the protagonist’s point of view. It is a psychedelic noir questioning the very possibility of meaning and what it costs to keep looking for it.

Player Cities & Housing
